query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, and he chased a squirrel all the way across the neighborhood park, he was so excited he even knocked over a kid's bubble machine by accident, I had to apologize to the parent for ten minutes. On the way home I stopped at the corner bakery and picked up a strawberry croissant that was still warm, it was so flaky I got crumbs all over my jacket. Oh right, I actually reached out because I need to cancel my pending order, the order number is #W3361211, and the reason for cancellation is that the items are no longer needed.
